create_pipeline_pag_controlnet_inpaint: create a StableDiffusionControlNetPAGInpaintPipeline for image inpainting with ControlNet guidance and perturbed attention guidance
run_pipeline_inpaint_call: run the pipeline __call__ method to generate inpainted images from a prompt, source image, mask, and control image
encode_prompt_text_embeddings: encode text prompts into CLIP text encoder hidden states with optional LoRA scale and clip skip support
prepare_control_image_preprocess: prepare and preprocess ControlNet conditioning images with resizing, batching, and classifier-free guidance duplication
prepare_latents_inpaint: prepare initial latents for inpainting by encoding the source image and combining with noise at the specified timestep
